```yaml
name: Release Studio

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.19'
          check-latest: true

      - name: Run make format
        run: make format

      - name: Run make check-command-docs
        run: make check-command-docs

      - name: Run make lint
        run: make lint

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN: 1
        run: make test

  release:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.19'
          check-latest: true

      - name: Create release notes
        id: create_release_notes
        run: echo "::set-output name=release_notes::$(git log --pretty=format:'%h %ad %s' --date=short $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)..HEAD)"

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ github.token }}
          tag: ${{ github.ref }}
          file: dist/app-store-connect-cli-linux-amd64.zip
          asset_name: app-store-connect-cli-linux-amd64.zip
          overwrite: true
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          make_latest: true
          release_name: ${{ github.event.release.name }}
          body: ${{ steps.create_release_notes.outputs.release_notes }}

  documentation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Create documentation
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/architecture
          echo "# Publishing Process Simplification" > docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "## Command Map" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "| Old Command | New Command | Description |" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "|-------------|-------------|-------------|" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "| `asc publish appstore` | `asc release run` | Deprecated, use new command." >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "| `asc submit create` | `asc release run` | Deprecated, use new command." >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "## Use What When" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "" >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
          echo "Use `asc release run` for all App Store publishing tasks." >> docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md
```
